document_title: Loi n° 09-08 relative à la protection des personnes physiques à l’égard du traitement des données à caractère personnel
target_name: 个人数据(données à caractère personnel)
clause_original_text: Article 43 : Le responsable d'un traitement ne peut transférer des données à caractère personnel vers un Etat étranger que si cet Etat assure un niveau de protection suffisant de la vie privée et des libertés et droits fondamentaux des personnes.
evidence_quote: Le responsable d'un traitement ne peut transférer des données à caractère personnel vers un Etat étranger que si cet Etat assure un niveau de protection suffisant
rationale: 摩洛哥第 09-08 号法律第 43 条明确限制个人数据向外国传输(transférer vers un Etat étranger)，要求充分保护水平

document_title: قانون رقم 151 لسنة 2020 بإصدار قانون حماية البيانات الشخصية (Law No. 151 of 2020 Personal Data Protection Law)
clause_original_text: المادة 14: يحظر إجراء عمليات نقل أو تخزين أو مشاركة للبيانات الشخصية التي تم جمعها أو تجهيزها للمعالجة إلى دولة أجنبية إلا بتوافر مستوى من الحماية لا يقل عن المستوى المنصوص عليه في هذا القانون وبترخيص أو تصريح من المركز.
evidence_quote: يحظر إجراء عمليات نقل أو تخزين أو مشاركة للبيانات الشخصية التي تم جمعها أو تجهيزها للمعالجة إلى دولة أجنبية إلا بتوافر مستوى من الحماية لا يقل عن المستوى المنصوص عليه في هذا القانون وبترخيص أو تصريح من المركز.
rationale: 埃及第 151/2020 号法第 14 条明确限制将个人数据传输或存储至外国(إلى دولة أجنبية)，须具备不低于本法的保护水准并取得中心许可

document_title: Courts (Civil and Criminal Justice) Reform Act 2021
source_name: Courts (Civil and Criminal Justice) Reform Act 2021
clause_original_text: The General Division of the High Court may order any civil proceedings to be transferred from the State Courts to the High Court.
evidence_quote: The General Division of the High Court may order any civil proceedings to be transferred from the State Courts to the High Court.
rationale: 典型历史错配: Courts Reform Act 中的 civil proceedings to be transferred 是法院案件移送，与个人数据跨境传输完全无关

clause_original_text: Section 25: An organisation must cease to retain its documents containing personal data as soon as it is reasonable to assume that the purpose for which that personal data was collected is no longer being served.
evidence_quote: An organisation must cease to retain its documents containing personal data as soon as it is reasonable to assume that the purpose for which that personal data was collected is no longer being served.
rationale: 第 25 条规定的是数据留存期限限制(cease to retain)，不含任何跨境传输或出境(transfer outside)语义

document_title: Road Traffic Act - Road Traffic (Autonomous Motor Vehicles) Rules 2017
target_name: 向LTA申请并取得自动驾驶机动车公共道路测试准入授权义务
clause_original_text: Rule 5(1): A person who wishes to undertake a trial of an autonomous motor vehicle on any public road must apply to the Authority for an authorisation in accordance with these Rules.
evidence_quote: A person who wishes to undertake a trial of an autonomous motor vehicle on any public road must apply to the Authority for an authorisation in accordance with these Rules.
rationale: 2017 年自动驾驶规则第 5(1) 条规定开展自动驾驶公共道路测试必须向陆路交通管理局(LTA)申请准入授权

document_title: Application for Trial of Autonomous Motor Vehicles for Public Road Operations
source_name: Application for Trial of Autonomous Motor Vehicles for Public Road Operations
target_name: 提交自动驾驶路测安全评估、责任保险与黑匣子技术方案准入材料义务
clause_original_text: Applicants seeking approval for a trial of autonomous motor vehicles on public roads must submit the safety assessment report, third-party liability insurance policy and data recorder specification to LTA prior to vehicle deployment.
evidence_quote: Applicants seeking approval for a trial of autonomous motor vehicles on public roads must submit the safety assessment report, third-party liability insurance policy and data recorder specification to LTA prior to vehicle deployment.
rationale: 新加坡 LTA 自动驾驶路测准入指南要求部署前提交安全评估、三责险与黑匣子方案审批

document_title: Loi organique n° 2004-63 du 27 juillet 2004 portant sur la protection des données à caractère personnel
target_name: 个人数据跨境传输前向突尼斯INPDP申请事前许可义务
clause_original_text: Article 52 : Dans tous les cas, le transfert de données à caractère personnel vers un pays étranger ne peut avoir lieu sans l'autorisation de l'Instance nationale de protection des données à caractère personnel.
evidence_quote: le transfert de données à caractère personnel vers un pays étranger ne peut avoir lieu sans l'autorisation de l'Instance nationale de protection des données à caractère personnel.
rationale: 突尼斯 2004-63 号法第 52 条要求任何个人数据跨境传输必须事先取得 INPDP 的授权许可(autorisation)

clause_original_text: A person must apply to the Authority for an authorisation.
evidence_quote: A person must apply to the Authority for an authorisation.
rationale: 违反类型约束矩阵: REQUIRES_ADMISSION 不允许 DATA_CATEGORY -> PENALTY

target_name: 自动驾驶路测准入许可
clause_original_text: Section 21(1): On request of an individual, an organisation must provide the individual with personal data about the individual that is in the possession or under the control of the organisation.
evidence_quote: On request of an individual, an organisation must provide the individual with personal data about the individual that is in the possession or under the control of the organisation.
rationale: PDPA 第 21(1) 条规定的是个人查阅权(access request)，不含任何准入许可、路测审批或备案授权语义
